StringWithMarkup.String: Nonanol appears as colorless liquid with a rose or fruity odor. Floats on water. Freezing point 23 °F. (USCG, 1999)

Nonan-1-ol is a nonanol that is nonane substituted by a hydroxy group at position 1. It has been isolated as a component of volatile oils from plants like Hordeum vulgare. It has a role as a volatile oil component, a flavouring agent, an antifungal agent and a plant metabolite. It is a primary alcohol and a nonanol.
1-nonanol has been reported in Humulus lupulus, Zea mays, and other organisms with data available.
